references.text: The same offering regulation for birds is mentioned - a turtledove or young pigeon as a sin offering for the poor
Turtledoves or young pigeons are used as purification offerings after childbirth
Two turtledoves or young pigeons are mentioned as an offering for cleansing from leprosy
Turtledoves or young pigeons as a purification offering for uncleanness
The Nazirite shall bring two turtledoves or two young pigeons to the priest
Mary and Joseph brought an offering of turtledoves or young pigeons according to the Lord's law, in fulfillment of this regulation
